# EloqData

> EloqData is a next-generation converged database that breaks the memory barrier with NVMe storage, offering Redis and MongoDB compatibility, ACID transactions, and AI-native workload support.

EloqData provides a multi-model database platform featuring EloqKV (distributed key-value store), EloqDoc (document storage), and EloqCloud deployment options. The platform leverages NVMe and SSD storage to overcome traditional DRAM limitations while maintaining Redis protocol compatibility and ACID guarantees.

## Key Topics

- EloqKV - Distributed key-value store with Redis compatibility
- ACID transactions - Full transactional support across operations
- Redis-compatible - Drop-in replacement for Redis workloads
- MongoDB-compatible - Document database compatibility
- NVMe storage - High-performance persistent storage layer
- RESP2/RESP3 protocols - Redis serialization protocol support
- Converged database - Multi-model unified architecture
- AI-native workloads - Optimized for AI agent applications
- EloqCloud - Cloud deployment and management
- Multi-tenancy - EloqKV Proxy for cluster management
- RocksDB - Local storage engine integration
- Prometheus/Grafana - Monitoring and observability
- Lua scripting - Server-side script execution
- Pub/Sub messaging - Channel-based messaging patterns

- [Install from Binary](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqdoc/install-from-binary): EloqDoc binary installation guide with RocksDB local storage setup

## Platform & Infrastructure

- [EloqKV Proxy](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/eloqkv-proxy): EloqKV Proxy guide: multi-tenancy, cluster management, Redis compatibility
- [Monitor Overview](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/monitor): EloqKV monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana for performance metrics

## List Commands Reference

- [RPUSH](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/list/RPUSH): RPUSH command: append values to list end with RESP2/RESP3 protocols
- [RPUSHX](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/list/RPUSHX): RPUSHX command: append to list only if exists, Redis-compatible
- [LPOP](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/list/LPOP): LPOP command: remove and return first elements from list with RESP support
- [RPOP](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/list/RPOP): RPOP command: remove and return last element from list with RESP support
- [BRPOP](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/list/BRPOP): BRPOP command: blocking pop from list tail in Redis-compatible EloqKV
- [LRANGE](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/list/LRANGE): LRANGE command: retrieve list elements by index range with RESP2/RESP3
- [LREM](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/list/LREM): LREM command: remove matching elements from list with count control

## Hash & Set Commands Reference

- [HDEL](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/hash/HDEL): HDEL command reference: remove fields from hash with RESP2/RESP3 support
- [SADD](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/set/SADD): SADD command: add members to set with RESP2/RESP3 support

## String & Bitmap Commands Reference

- [BITCOUNT](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/bitmap/BITCOUNT): BITCOUNT command reference: count set bits in string with RESP2/RESP3

## Pub/Sub & Scripting Commands Reference

- [PSUBSCRIBE](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/pubsub/PSUBSCRIBE): PSUBSCRIBE command: pattern-based channel subscription with wildcards
- [EVAL](https://www.eloqdata.com/eloqkv/scripting/EVAL): EVAL command: execute Lua scripts server-side for atomic operations
